name: timegrid-cli
description: 在 Obsidian 外查看 TimeGrid 任务的命令行工具

scripts.today: npm run build && node dist/tg.mjs today
scripts.html: npm run build && node dist/tg.mjs html
scripts.where: npm run build && node dist/tg.mjs where
scripts.overdue: npm run build && node dist/tg.mjs overdue
scripts.upcoming: npm run build && node dist/tg.mjs upcoming
scripts.search: npm run build && node dist/tg.mjs search
